title: USB-C Charger × Device Compatibility and Charging Time
description:
For every pair of popular devices (phones, tablets, laptops, handheld consoles) and chargers: will it charge, the power the two negotiate over USB-C Power Delivery, PPS, AVS or vendor protocols, whether that is the device's full charging speed, what caps the power (the charger, the device or a missing protocol), and estimated 0–50% and 0–100% charging times. Device and charger specifications come from the makers' official pages.

The data shows that watts alone do not decide charging speed: about a quarter of all pairs are held back by a missing protocol (mostly PPS for Samsung and Google phones) rather than by power, and a 45 W charger with PPS reaches full speed on more devices than a 140 W charger without it.

The file is generated by the same engine as Can It Charge? and refreshed from the site every week; each refresh is a new version of this record. Charging times are estimates: scaled from a published manufacturer charging time where one exists, otherwise computed from battery capacity. Method: canitcharge.com/how-we-calculate/.
